executor_profile.justification: Five new reducer/harness modules plus a /retro skill extension composing around one non-negotiable invariant (no signal ever writes the registry); team-execution consensus review catches a missed direct-write path, sonnet/high suffices since every mechanism (hash-chained ledger, fixed-suite benchmark, SPC charts, Elo updates, staleness joins) is a well-specified, already-precedented pattern (outcome_costs.py leaf-produced-fact discipline, Registry.stale()) rather than a novel architecture call. No case for opus or an external engine. Effort is target posture: not a live team-execution dispatch knob until pf-effort-first-class lands; teammates inherit session tier until then.

source_artifact.content_excerpt: A /retro sub-step aggregates reconciliation-ledger outcomes into per-cell rating-drift proposals against engine-registry.yaml, proposal-only, human-applied (T1-F3-7). An automated provider-benchmark harness proposes registry rating/cost updates from a fixed eval suite (T2-F1-7). A ledger-fed staleness report arms /retro to revalidate ratings from evidence (T2-F4-7). Capabilities are Elo-rated, learning from reconciliation outcomes (T2-F5-5). SPC control charts detect provider cost/latency drift and flag rows for re-validation (T2-F5-7). A flight-data-recorder cost ledger is append-only and tamper-evident (T2-F5-8).
